name: Guernica (Spain)
description: Crimson field with a white bend sinister from the upper fly to the lower hoist, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Guernica (the oak of Guernica on white above a green base, inscribed GERNIKA LUMO).
history: Municipal flag of Guernica; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
